name: MulmoTerminal
tagline: Run multiple Claude Code and Codex sessions in parallel — and see which one needs you.

interface.note: Real ptys rendered in a browser tab; several live terminals visible at once rather than one row per session.

os.windows: CI nightly; no native tmux, so sessions are not persistent there

execution: local — code and API keys stay on your machine

features.mobile: responsive web UI + web push (no native app)

notFor: container-per-agent isolation — worktrees only; the Docker sandbox was removed in 4.0.0
a native mobile app — the phone gets the same browser UI
running agents on someone else's machine

maintainers.notable: Satoshi Nakajima — software architect for Windows 95, Windows 98 and Internet Explorer 3.0/4.0 at Microsoft
priorWork: VideoShader (2015) — GPU video processing for iOS, built at Veemob
Swipe (2015) — an animation runtime that made manga move on phones, MIT
OwnPlate (2020) — takeout ordering for restaurants during COVID, run at the Singularity Society and launched with ITOCHU
